pr51.body:
## Why

An exact value certificate would repair C053's child-cache origin failure, but early publication still needs authority through the first parent use. C054 finds a concrete gap: a reference_pose-tag resident key passes pi-only screening and can mutate the newly published interval during the intervening base-tip lookup.

## What this adds

This evidence-only checkpoint preserves all2917 parent files and adds43 C054 source-review, independent-review, validation and handoff records.

- T1 pi-only early-publication admission is NO-GO by a conditional source witness. Both base-tip probes still miss; no dictionary table/order mutation or executed hostile request is claimed.
- D36's explicitly selected generic36-callable ×5-identity-predicate screen costs at least180 against163 available operations. This rejects that schedule, not every use-sensitive gate.
- T2's linear three-tag screen repairs the named witness only. Its two-pass floor is6*(m_before+m_after); full owner/precharge/cost closure remains unproved.
- C055 is a distinct bounded source question: a use-sensitive exact native128 specialization at the original cold-pi miss, retaining original lookup and final remember. Factory room remains163. No constants, implementation or collector are selected.

## Validation

Three independent final audits bind the same five core drafts, with40 substantive checks and zero unresolved findings. One discriminator-boundary wording correction and its earlier drafts are preserved.

The unchanged documentation checker passes29 preserved sources /233 sections,243 documents,1881 local links and94 anchors. The metadata audit passes11 grouped checks. Both commands retain882 stable named inputs.

The partial snapshot has851 exact parent files /119372542bytes, including all238 original Markdown/HTML documents and21 local runtime modules. A separate complete remote65-module comparison matches heldC035. Historical blobs were recovered exactly; no archive-internal audit is claimed.

All43 new files /1178826bytes were read back from immutable commit `2aca5afb05a0320971ccaf9d9ce30904d120e249`, tree `7082ceb840e0ce4c2f30baccbdb527913e9fa2ca`. Every parent path/blob/mode remains unchanged.

## Scope and remaining work

No runtime source change, OntoKin import, endpoint computation, original/candidate request, collector, runtime test, benchmark, hosted dispatch or main merge occurred. Original28 remains24/28; P11/P16/P23/L03 remain unresolved; C035 remains held including adverse timing. All original limits and release gates remain.

Start with [HANDOFF-054](https://github.com/Omegapy/OntoKin/blob/2aca5afb05a0320971ccaf9d9ce30904d120e249/docs/engineering/reach-recording-validation-2026-10-23/HANDOFF-054.md), the [exact source review](https://github.com/Omegapy/OntoKin/blob/2aca5afb05a0320971ccaf9d9ce30904d120e249/docs/engineering/reach-recording-validation-2026-10-23/checkpoint-054-pi-certificate-feasibility.md) and [C055 scope](https://github.com/Omegapy/OntoKin/blob/2aca5afb05a0320971ccaf9d9ce30904d120e249/docs/engineering/reach-recording-validation-2026-10-23/checkpoint-054-next-scope.json). Final ownership release is recorded separately in Issue26.
